analysis: Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source text. These changes document watchdog restart acknowledgement rather than supply executable controls. docs/developer/test.md head 318–334 describes scripted missing-service handling, exact prior crash-loop guard restoration and suppression of the trip callback; it explicitly does not claim native race qualification. docs/provider/installation.md head 217–224 and changelog.d/watchdog-kickstart-acknowledgement.md head 3 describe leaving stopped/uninstalled jobs unloaded. No concrete security regression or material threat-model contradiction is established by these documentation changes. Relevant boundaries are TB-003 and watchdog recovery threat T-043; lifecycle interaction with credential-holding process shutdown also merits checking against A-008. Integration should reconcile these documented contracts with provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Service/LaunchAgent.swift (kickstartIfLoaded), WatchdogRecoveryService.swift (recoverDownProvider), the disk-backed guard implementation and LaunchAgentLifecycleTests.swift: verify missing-service classification versus permission failures, preservation of preexisting guard state, and no reload after intentional stop/uninstall. Those implementations were not supplied in this batch, so their correctness and concurrent rollback behavior remain unverified, not findings. No supplied change alters authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or data exposure.
